title: 第17章 美人图鉴第18章 天星宗的奇葩
slug: 加入合欢宗后师妹的鱼塘炸了
content_zh:
第17章美人图鉴在穆荷的宣传下，整个宗门都知道云洛一个月领悟了《月海潮音诀》第一层。
所过之处，皆是同门艳羡敬佩的目光。
云洛怕自己太骄傲，干脆也不出灵犀峰了，安安心心练自己的剑。
她练的是穆荷自创的招式，与她的道号一样，名为《惊鸿》。
惊鸿剑诀，剑起如惊鸿掠影，一抹寒光乍破长空。
收剑时剑意未退，如鸿雁远去，余韵悠长。
或许是她修为和阅历尚浅，在剑意的领悟上始终差了一点。
导致她每次练完剑，都感觉像老夫老妻的x生活。
做了又像没做。
可能是识海拓宽了，又练了两百遍后，她终于隐隐摸到了剑意的影子。
“师父，我好像摸到剑意了。”
穆荷今日盯着她练剑，早已看出。
“嗯，的确摸到剑意的影子了，不过这只是开始，莫要懈怠。”
云洛怕过一晚就找不到感觉，当即也顾不得休息，拿起玄铁剑再次练习。
又练了几十遍，确定已经掌握窍门方才作罢。
穆荷喝着茶，唇角含笑。
“你倒是能吃苦。”
云洛喝了口穆荷为她准备的灵茶，终于感觉顺过气。
“师父，我这不叫能吃苦，而是选择性吃苦。要是不吃修仙的苦，就要吃生老病死的苦。”
现代的时候她也是对自己说：不吃学习的苦，难道以后吃婚姻的苦？

最后才终于如愿考上心仪的学校。
“你个小鬼头。”
穆荷摇摇头，但细想她说得似乎有那么一点道理。
“明日就要动身前往归墟秘境，今日就练到这。另外……”
她递给云洛一支玉瓶。
“这是你修复水灵根所需的丹药，金属性丹药所需灵植已经凑齐，但还需要一些时日炼制。
此外火属性和土属性的灵植还各差一味，分别是九焰烈阳花和戊土麒麟芝。
这两样灵植生长条件极为严苛，无法在灵田种植。
为师已经发出悬赏令，平日你也可留意一番，若是自己取不到，可联系宗内长老去取。”
眼眶突然有些热，云洛握着玉瓶，觉得似有千斤重。
没想到这一个月，自己在藏经阁修炼，师父竟在外面为她苦炼丹药。
content_en:
Chapter 17 Beauty Illustrated Under Mu He's propaganda, the entire sect knew that Yun Luo had comprehended the first level of "Moon Sea Chao Yin Jue" in one month.
Everywhere he passed, his classmates looked at him with envy and admiration.
Yunluo was afraid that he would be too proud, so he simply stopped leaving Lingxi Peak and practiced his sword with peace of mind.
What she practices is Mu He's own move, which is the same as her Taoist name, called "Jinghong".
In the Jinghong Sword Technique, the sword rises like a glimpse of a giant, and a flash of cold light breaks through the sky.
When sheathing the sword, the sword's intention has not receded, like a wild goose flying away, leaving a long lingering aftertaste.
Perhaps because her cultivation and experience are still shallow, her understanding of the sword's meaning has always been a bit behind.
As a result, every time she finished sword practice, she felt like the sex life of an old married couple.
It’s done but it seems like it’s not done.
Perhaps it was because her sea of ​​consciousness had broadened. After practicing it another two hundred times, she finally faintly felt the shadow of the sword's intention.
"Master, I seem to have felt the sword's will."
Mu He had already seen it when he watched her practice sword practice today.
"Well, I have indeed touched the shadow of Sword Intent, but this is just the beginning, don't slack off."
Yunluo was afraid that he wouldn't be able to feel anything after one night, so he immediately picked up the Black Iron Sword and practiced again without taking a rest.
I practiced it dozens of times and only gave up when I was sure I had mastered the trick.
Mu He drank tea with a smile on his lips.
"You can endure hardship."
Yunluo took a sip of the spiritual tea prepared by Mu He and finally felt relieved.
"Master, I don't mean to be able to endure hardship, but to endure hardship selectively. If you don't suffer the hardship of cultivating immortality, you will have to endure the hardship of birth, old age, sickness and death."
In modern times, she also said to herself: If I don't suffer the hardship of study, will I suffer the hardship of marriage in the future?
Finally, I finally got into the school of my choice.
"You little brat."
Mu He shook his head, but thinking about it carefully, what she said seemed to make sense.
"Tomorrow I will leave for the Guixu Secret Realm, and I will finish my training today. In addition..."
She handed Yunluo a jade bottle.
"This is the elixir you need to repair the water spirit root. The spiritual plants required for the metallic elixir have been gathered, but it will take some time to refine.
In addition, the spiritual plants with fire attributes and earth attributes are also different, namely the Nine-Flame Sunflower and the Wutu Qilin Zhi.
The growth conditions for these two spiritual plants are extremely harsh and cannot be grown in spiritual fields.
The teacher has issued a reward order. You can also pay attention to it on weekdays. If you can't get it yourself, you can contact the elders in the sect to get it. "
His eyes suddenly felt hot. Yun Luo held the jade bottle and felt it weighed a thousand pounds.
Unexpectedly, this month, while she was practicing in the Sutra Pavilion, her master would be working hard to refine elixirs for her outside.
